description: Query EU AI Act regulatory updates from primary sources, newest first. Filters (date range, source, topics, severity) apply to the whole register before limit. Every event has the same shape in all tools: id, source_id, event_type, severity, topics, title_en, title_de, summary_en, summary_de, url_official, url_kind ("official", or "secondary" where no official publication was found), ai_act_articles (array), version, published_at (ISO 8601).

since.description: ISO 8601 date or timestamp, e.g. "2026-11-01" or "2026-11-01T00:00:00Z". Only events published at or after this. Optional.

source_id.description: Source id. 22 active sources: aiboard, aioffice, bfdi, bnetza, bsi, cen, cnil, codeofpractice, curia, cz-ctu, digitalstrategy, dsk, ec-spoc, edpb, etsi, eurlex, fra, lv-ptac, nl-algoritmeregister, nl-ap, servicedesk, sk-mirri. Paused (no events): haveyoursay, oecd-ai. Historical (no longer fetched, past events stay queryable): consilium, edps, ep, iso, national-be, national-dk, national-es, national-fr, national-ie, national-it, national-pl, rtr. Optional.

topics.description: Events with at least one of these topics. Fixed taxonomy, see https://docs.aiactradar.com/concepts/topics/. Optional.

until.description: ISO 8601 date or timestamp, e.g. "2026-11-01" or "2026-11-01T00:00:00Z". Only events published at or before this. Optional.

name: query_ai_act_updates
